title: Pointwise bound by Fourier sparsity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $x$ be a point of the sign cube. The square of $f(x)$ is at most the Fourier sparsity of $f$ times the uniform average of $f(y)^2$ over the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
